profile.headline: “Your talent determines what you can do. Your motivation determines how much you’re willing to do. Your attitude determines how well you do it.” -Lou Holtz
profile.summary: Enthusiastic and self motivated Application Developer with strong background in software design, development and testing. Great social skills. I am always ready to take on challenges and pursue learning opportunities that help me improve development/maintenance of software applications. Reliable team player committed to the work at hand and able to adapt to new environments very quickly. Bilingual; can read/write/speak in English and Spanish.
